description: Three independent DBL constants (NaN, positive infinity, negative infinity) wired directly to connector-pane indicators; no inputs, arithmetic, subVIs or hardware dependencies.
encoding: Nonfinite numbers use tagged JSON objects: {"float":"nan"}, {"float":"inf"}, {"float":"-inf"}. Finite negative zero uses {"float":"-0.0"} where relevant. JSON NaN/Infinity tokens are never used.
limits: Numeric class and infinity sign are compared; NaN payload/sign, status flags and other LabVIEW versions are not established.
